phase: Phase 1: Audit roles may run role-gate (due 2026-11-26)
summary: Phase 1 meets spec FR-1 to FR-4 and all six acceptance criteria at HEAD d94646f. All 8 audit role files hold the role-gate allow rule after the truncate deny and before the redirect denies. The contract test and the full runner exit 0. One nonblocking Nit remains: Task 1.4 records no diff stat. No finding blocks acceptance.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Task 1.4 is marked [x], but plan.md records no diff stat. The task text requires the PR number, the check result, and the diff stat in the plan. The Task 1.3 evidence records the first two. No line records the stat. Rationale: the task closes without one of its three records, and the earlier chore recorded its stat in the same task. Git holds the stat, so no product behavior changes. Fix: add one line to the Task 1.4 evidence with a pinned range. For example, `git diff --shortstat 3c694b5 900b491` gives 15 files changed, 284 insertions(+), and `git diff --shortstat 3e78c79 900b491` gives 10 files changed, 180 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-). A plan-only commit advances HEAD, so the orchestrator decides whether to rerun this gate.
evidence: HEAD is d94646f8a69506bd318f88b0928b9ba3d536e88a on chore/audit-role-gate-allow. The tree was clean at the start and at the end of the audit. role_base_sha equals audited_head_sha. phase_base_sha is 3e78c79.

In agents/measure-spec-review.md the numbers are 97, 100, and 103, 106, 109. The allow rule follows the truncate rule directly and precedes the redirect denies directly. Each file holds exactly 1 allow rule with this resource.

Change set limit (FR-2): the phase diff holds no closeout file. measure/tech-debt.md, measure/archive, CHANGELOG.md, README.md, and measure/tracks.md are all absent from it. The whole branch diff 3c694b5..d94646f lists measure/tracks.md once, from setup commit 02e6684 (4 added lines, the Active Tracks entry). That is the track registration, not a closeout change. run.sh, the installer, and every other role file are untouched.

Installer (FR-4): bin/install-targets.tsv line 14 ships agents with the glob measure-*.md to ~/.config/opencode/agents. It names no file and holds no hash, so the installer needs no change. The installed-copy proof after the merge stays with the orchestrator.

Tests through heavy-run at the audited HEAD: bash tests/spec_review_gate/test_audit_role_gate_allow.sh exits 0 with 88 checks, PASS=88, FAIL=0. bash tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh exits 0 with 25 suites, PASS=25, FAIL=0. The new suite runs because run.sh discovers test_*.sh, so run.sh needs no edit.

The other CI steps also pass at the audited HEAD: tests/dsh/run.sh exits 0 with 15 passed and 0 failed, and both check-parity.sh scripts print parity: ok. CI ran these four commands at the pushed head 900b491 (.github/workflows/ci.yml lines 18-21, fetch-depth 0, so the base commit 3c694b5 is readable).

Fail-first proof, reproduced. I built a scratch root from git archive of the 3e78c79 agent files plus the Red test of 2247555 and ran the test with GIT_DIR set to the repo. It exits 1 with 88 checks, PASS=56, FAIL=32. This equals the Red record in plan.md. I removed the scratch root. The test file is unchanged since Red: git diff --quiet 2247555 d94646f -- tests exits 0.

Independent rule evaluation. I wrote a separate awk evaluator (glob to regex, last match wins, a trailing ' *' also matches the bare value). It checked 19 command shapes in each of the 8 files and found 0 mismatches. The shapes include four that the contract test does not run: ' >out.txt', ' >> out.txt', ' >>out.txt', and '>>out.txt'. All four give deny, so the declined Review A F1 is a coverage gap and not a behavior defect.

The 19 shapes also confirm these results in all 8 files. The role-gate command of the brief gives allow. The failing 'rm (' heading, an absolute script path, and a chain with rm or cp give allow (accepted gap). A spaced redirect and a chained spaced redirect give deny. The forms 2>&1 and an unspaced > give allow (existing gap). A command with echo or cd before the role-gate form gives deny. The commands rm, cp, and git commit alone give deny.

A second check with my own rule extractor in bash passed 104 of 104 checks. The base-commit file 3e78c79 with the failing heading gives deny in all 8 files, which proves the bug. The file at HEAD gives allow. The closeout shape keeps its effect from the base commit 3c694b5.
The v2_shell_effect and rules functions in the new test equal those in tests/spec_review_gate/test_s2_role_docs.sh byte for byte (12 and 6 lines), as FR-3 requires.

Plan claims reproduce. The SHAs resolve: 2247555 is the Red commit (the test file), 8b41988 is the Green commit (the 8 agent files), and 77876fa added the PR evidence that Tasks 1.3 and 1.4 cite. All 4 tasks are marked [x] and each carries a SHA.

PR facts from gh pr view 48 and git ls-remote: state OPEN, mergedAt null, head 900b491, check checks SUCCESS in run 45144937306 (09:12:26Z to 09:17:35Z, 5m9s). origin/main is 3c694b5, as the plan says. HEAD is 2 plan-only commits ahead of the pushed head (git rev-list --count 900b491..HEAD prints 2), so the 2 records commits are not pushed yet.

Anti-pattern checks. A3 absent: the test has no count or baseline assertion, and its line-number compares run only after a non-blank check. A4 absent: the test has no markers-consistent check, and every extract is asserted non-blank before a compare. A5: every pass claim in plan.md reproduces (Red PASS=56 FAIL=32, the passing runner, the PR facts); the absent diff stat is F1. A6 does not apply: measure/tracks.md is outside the phase diff. A7 absent: the test uses exact fixed strings.

Task and criteria check. Tasks 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3 hold. Task 1.4 holds for the PR number and the check result (both in the Task 1.3 evidence) but not for the diff stat (F1). All six acceptance criteria hold: allow with a chain, deny with a matched redirect, the unspaced gap, the old denies, the fail-first proof, and the unchanged installer.
Accepted gaps from the brief, not findings: a chain after the role-gate form is allowed, an unspaced redirect stays allowed, and Review A F1 is declined to tech-debt.

Observation, no finding: the allow rule sits after the git-write denies as well as the rm denies. A chain after the role-gate form therefore also passes a git write. In all 8 files, the role-gate form followed by a git push gives allow and git push alone gives deny. The accepted chain gap covers this. The closeout tech-debt row can name it.

Limits. No live proof exists before the merge: the test evaluates the permission text with a re-implementation of the rules, FR-4 assigns the installed-copy proof to the orchestrator, and this session ran with the previously installed role file. I built no misplacement mutants. The order assertion at test lines 132-145 pins the rule position, and I read those lines without running a mutant. The test pins its list of 8 files, so a future ninth audit role with the rm deny stays uncovered.

Process note. My first commands were rejected because the strings I tested held rm, cp, or a redirect operator, and one held a shell construct that the scanner could not analyze. I rebuilt those strings at run time inside awk and bash. I ran no denied command, and I did not turn measure-guard off.

No test-strategy.md exists for the track or the project, so no strategy violation applies. The folder measure/runs is git-ignored (.gitignore:213), so the run artifacts stay local and the tree stays clean.
